purpose: Teach: 天神/芦屋/藤岡/萩原/フィジカル/エキサイトブログ/ハンナ/ケインズ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが福岡の天神に出張に行かれた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he took a business trip to Tenjin in Fukuoka.
lines.style: Nostalgic, slightly distant gaze. Warm but removed, as though remembering something precious and untouchable. Measured pace. Soft landing on the place name.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、芦屋の高級住宅街を散策されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and didn't you, when you were young, take walks through the upscale neighborhoods of Ashiya, dear?
lines.style: Playful turn-around. Knowing lilt on the question. Gentle teasing beneath the warmth — she's heard this before and is gently redirecting him. Tender but sharp.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが藤岡弘、の主演ドラマを観られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he watched dramas starring Hiroshi Fujiwara.
lines.style: Same wistful distance as before. A rhythm settling in. Softer this time, like he's drifting through these memories almost unconsciously. Trailing off slightly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、漫画家萩原一至の作品を蔵書されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, and didn't you, when you were young, collect works by manga artist Kazushi Hagiwara, dear?
lines.style: Matching his rhythm now, but with more conviction underneath. She knows exactly what he's doing. Light, almost musical delivery. A gentle insistence wrapped in affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフィジカル、つまり体力鍛錬を続けられた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he kept up with physical training — strength and endurance work.
lines.style: The same measured, nostalgic tone continuing. A slight pause before 'physical training,' as though he's recalling the specific detail. Quiet and contemplative.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、エキサイトブログのご自身のページを書かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, and didn't you, when you were young, write your own blog page on Excite Blog, dear?
lines.style: Warmer now, almost laughing at him without letting it show. She's caught him in his own pattern. Slightly raised pitch on 'dear,' with affection and mild exasperation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが米国ピアニストのハンナを愛された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he loved the American pianist Hanna.
lines.style: Softer opening. A note of genuine feeling creeping in beneath the wistfulness. Slower on 'loved' — almost vulnerable. The rhythm is breaking slightly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ケインズ経済学を学ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, and didn't you, when you were young, study Keynesian economics, dear?
lines.style: Closer now, almost intimate. She's not teasing anymore — she's meeting him where he is. Quieter, with the smallest smile in her voice. The 'dear' is real.
